agents.notes: Architecture, decomposition, complex reasoning, review, integration design, and high-leverage implementation. Requires repository/GitHub visibility to operate on current code.

Claude Code Desktop lead. Decomposes work, coordinates subagents, integrates and verifies. CAPABILITY-REGISTRY CORRECTION, round 78, approved by gpt-architect after the round-77 handoff: `Recommendations` was added because PL-0801 is already implemented in committed history, this agent had already performed the historical and provenance analysis needed to reconcile it, and the only thing refusing the claim was that no local agent advertised the lane. The three alternatives were each worse and were each named in the ruling: changing PL-0801's lane would be false, rebuilding under gpt-architect would duplicate committed work, and hand-editing past the refusal is the move PL-0703 was blocked for. This states a capability that has already been demonstrated. It is NOT a licence to broaden any other agent's capabilities for symmetry, and none were.

Raised from 1 to 2. It is the only agent advertising Frontend, so with a limit of 1 a single task sitting in REVIEW behind an external reviewer stopped every other frontend lane -- dispatch reported 'no conflict-free executable tasks' while two P0 tasks were finished and waiting. The limit exists to prevent overlapping writes, and overlap is already prevented structurally by allowedPaths, which the control plane enforces per claim. Two is deliberate rather than unlimited: it lets one task wait on review while another proceeds, without pretending one agent can hold an open-ended number of surfaces at once.

Raised from 1 to 2 on 2026-09-15, on exactly the precedent claude-frontend set and claude-media followed, for the identical reason and with the identical bound. This is the only local agent advertising Backend or Provider, so with a limit of 1 a single task sitting in REVIEW behind an external reviewer stopped the whole lane: PL-0405 moved to REVIEW for gpt-architect and ai:dispatch immediately reported 'no conflict-free executable tasks', with PL-0301 deferred for capacity alone -- not for paths, which had just been narrowed to be disjoint from every active task, and not for dependencies, which were satisfied. PL-0301 is the P0 that gates PL-0302, PL-0501, PL-0502, PL-0701 and PL-0702, so one external verdict was holding the entire M4 playback vertical slice behind a capacity number rather than behind any real conflict. THE LIMIT EXISTS TO PREVENT OVERLAPPING WRITES, AND OVERLAP IS ALREADY PREVENTED STRUCTURALLY by allowedPaths, which conflictWithActive enforces on every claim and refuses regardless of owner. So raising this changes nothing about safety: PL-0305 and PL-0301 remain subject to the same path arithmetic they were before, and a genuinely overlapping pair stays mutually exclusive. Two rather than unlimited is deliberate, in the same words the other two lanes used: it lets one task wait on review while another proceeds, without pretending one agent can hold an open-ended number of surfaces at once.

Two rather than unlimited is deliberate, in the same words claude-frontend used: it lets one task wait on review while another proceeds, without pretending one agent can hold an open-ended number of surfaces at once.

Raised from 1 to 2 on 2026-10-03 (round 109), on exactly the precedent claude-frontend set, claude-media followed and claude-backend was raised under on 2026-09-15, for the identical reason and with the identical bound. This is the ONLY local agent advertising Test, so with a limit of 1 a single task sitting in REVIEW behind an external reviewer stopped the whole lane: PW-0602 moved to REVIEW for gpt-architect and ai:dispatch immediately reported 'No conflict-free executable tasks can be assigned with current agent capacity', deferring PL-0720 for capacity alone. PL-0720 is the board's P0 -- no test drives a signed-in viewer through to an operable player on a production build -- and its single allowedPath is a file that does not yet exist, disjoint from PW-0602's surface in both fields in both directions. So the capacity number, not any real conflict, was holding the highest-priority open task behind an external verdict.

THE LIMIT EXISTS TO PREVENT OVERLAPPING WRITES, AND OVERLAP IS ALREADY PREVENTED STRUCTURALLY by allowedPaths, which conflictWithActive enforces on every claim and refuses regardless of owner. PW-0503 is the proof in the same wave: it is deferred for a real path overlap with PW-0602 and stays deferred after this change, because the path arithmetic is untouched. Two rather than unlimited is deliberate, in the same words the other three lanes used: it lets one task wait on review while another proceeds, without pretending one agent can hold an open-ended number of surfaces at once. No capability was added to this or any agent, and no gate, reviewer restriction or self-approval rule is touched.

Raised from 1 to 2 on 2026-10-03 (round 109), on the same precedent and under the same three conditions as the claude-test raise earlier that round and the claude-backend raise on 2026-09-15. ALL THREE MUST HOLD, so that this does not read as a licence to raise a limit whenever one is inconvenient. (1) It is the only local agent advertising Infra; no other agent in the registry advertises it, gpt-architect included. (2) The lane was stopped by an EXTERNAL VERDICT rather than by work: PW-0208 sat in REVIEW for gpt-architect and ai:dispatch deferred PL-0718 for capacity alone. (3) The surfaces are disjoint -- PL-0718 holds the single file apps/web/tsconfig.json, PW-0208 holds apps/desktop/** and docs/LICENSING.md.

The limit exists to prevent overlapping writes, and overlap is already prevented structurally by allowedPaths, which conflictWithActive enforces on every claim regardless of owner. PW-0502 is deferred for a real path overlap with PW-0208 in the same wave and stays deferred after this change.

NOT APPLIED where the conditions fail, which is the other half of having them: claude-frontend was also full with PW-0308 deferred for capacity and was NOT raised, because it is already at 2 and holding two distinct tasks -- the designed bound working rather than a lane closed by one verdict. claude-security was not raised either, because nothing is queued behind it. A limit is raised when it is starving a lane, never for symmetry.
